summary: Comprehensive testing of VakilDot - Iteration 2. All 17 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI working correctly with homepage, live lawyers section, signup/signin flows, dashboard, and settings page verified. PWA support (manifest.json, service-worker.js, icons) all functioning. New /api/client/my-lawyer and /api/client/my-cases endpoints working correctly.

minor.issue: Health endpoint at /health (root) returns HTML via external URL due to frontend SPA routing, works internally on localhost:8001

issues: Lawyer profile photo shows initials fallback (RK) since photo_url is null - this is expected behavior when lawyer hasn't uploaded photo

critical_code_review_comments: All requested features implemented and working: live lawyers endpoint with profile_photo field, /api/client/my-lawyer endpoint, /api/client/my-cases with assigned_lawyer_id
PWA support complete: manifest.json, service-worker.js, logo192.png, logo512.png all accessible
Photo upload syncs to localStorage in Settings.js handlePhotoUpload function
Go-live endpoint fetches latest photo_url from lawyers collection before saving to live_lawyers

success_rate.frontend: 100% (homepage, live lawyers, signup, signin, dashboard, settings all working)

seed_data_creation: Created test lawyer and test client users for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from this iteration are working correctly. Backend uses Firestore (not MongoDB). JWT tokens use 'user_id' field. Live lawyers endpoint returns profile_photo field. PWA files in /app/frontend/public/. Test client endpoints require user_role='client'.

details: Homepage loads with 'Live Legal Consultations' section
Live Now section shows '1 Online' count
Raj Kumar lawyer card displays with all fields (name, court, rating, rate, Join Stream button)
LIVE and VERIFIED badges visible on lawyer cards
GET /api/live/lawyers/live returns lawyers array with profile_photo field
Response includes id, name, profile_photo, rate_per_minute, specialization, court, is_live, rating
GET /api/client/my-lawyer endpoint exists and returns {'lawyer': null} for client with no assigned lawyer
GET /api/client/my-cases endpoint exists and returns {'cases': [], 'assigned_lawyer_id': null}
Both endpoints correctly reject lawyer role with 403 'Client access only'
/manifest.json served with correct VakilDot data, icons, theme_color
Service worker registration confirmed in console logs
Settings page has photo upload area with camera icon
handlePhotoUpload in Settings.js syncs photo_url to localStorage
GET /health returns healthy status with app: 'VakilDot'

mocked_apis_note: Wallet system returns dummy balance. Agora token generation returns null token (not integrated).
